name: Field Notes
description: An article set to a comfortable measure with notes in a wide margin, each level with the words it refers to and joined to them by a thin hand-drawn line.

props.name: children
props.description: The article: headings, paragraphs, Note and Figure parts. Text is set at 17px in a column of at most 36rem. From 52rem wide a margin column opens beside it for the notes; narrower, the notes fold into the text.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the article, which is centred and at most 56rem wide. Other article props are passed through.

props.name: children
props.description: The words the note refers to, inline in a paragraph.

props.name: note
props.description: The note. In the margin it sits with its first line level with the words, nudged down only to avoid an earlier note or a figure, and a hand-drawn line underlines the words and runs out to it; it is placed again whenever the text reflows. On narrow screens the words are dotted and followed by a small button; tapping either opens the note as an aside inside the paragraph.

props.name: mark
props.description: Marks the words with a brush annotation instead of the drawn underline; the line then starts beside the mark.

props.name: markColor
props.description: Ink colour of the brush mark.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the button that opens the note on narrow screens.

props.name: src
props.description: Image for the figure, shown at 2:1.

props.name: children
props.description: Your own figure content instead of an image.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the figure. It breaks out across the margin when there is one, and notes move below it.
